subject: [PATCH 8/9] mm/gup: batch contiguous same-folio PTEs into one refcount grab

2026-11-23.patch_summary: This patch optimizes the handling of large folios (mTHP) in the Linux kernel's memory management system by batching contiguous PTEs into one refcount grab, reducing the number of try_grab_folio() calls and improving performance. The patch introduces a new function gup_pte_batch_len() to determine how many PTEs can be committed as one run, and modifies the gup_grab_folio_pages() function to use this information. This change results in significant performance improvements for large folios, with a 12.8x reduction in execution time for 64 kB mTHP and a 5.9x improvement over the previous patch's changes.
